alerts.title: Hypothyroidism Management
alerts.message: Guidelines emphasize the importance of proper thyroid management. Patient shows elevated TSH (12.4 mIU/L) and low free T4, indicating potential under-treatment of hypothyroidism. Non-adherence to levothyroxine is noted, which could contribute to these lab findings.

evidence.recommended_action: Assess and adjust levothyroxine dose as needed, ensure patient adherence.

evidence.recommended_action: Consider alternative ART regimens if weight gain persists and is a concern.
